d: A religious gathering featuring Katha Vachak Dhirendra Krishna Shastri and organized by MLA Raja Bhaiya (Raghuraj Pratap Singh) has sparked a political debate in Uttar Pradesh. Was the event truly about devotion and Ram Katha, or did it become a platform for showcasing Thakur power and political influence? The presence of prominent personalities and Thakur leaders like Brij Bhushan Singh, Pawan Singh, Dhananjay Singh, Abhay Singh, Baba Ramdev, Nishikant Dubey and Sanjeev Balyan grabbed headlines.
